left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Childhood cancer survivors age  [AND] 1-18 years old who received intensive treatment which included anthracycline  [OR] and/or alkylating agent chemotherapy
-  Diseases which will be eligible include, high risk  [OR] or very high risk acute lymphoblastic leukemia, acute myeloid leukemia, [OR]  Hodgkin lymphoma, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, [OR]  sarcomas

right.raw_text:
Healthy controls:
• Healthy controls are defined as children ages  [AND] 1-18 years old who are free from diseases  [OR] or medical conditions that might be affected  [OR] by or have an impact on this research study

left.raw_text: Healthy controls will be matched with patients for age, sex, ethnicity, geographic region, and tanner stage, since it is known that these factors can affect the epigenetic signature of an individual

right.raw_text: Controls will already be having blood drawn as part of their routine care

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
Cancer survivors:
• Patients who have received a bone marrow transplant will not be eligible

right.raw_text:
Healthy controls:
• Age, sex, ethnicity, geographic region, and tanner stage matched controls with any acute  [OR] or chronic disease will be excluded
